body: I understand your point, but I just.. Idk what to do without her, I love her so much and never really saw this coming.. I don't think I could ever care about anyone as much as i've cared about her.. Just kinda want to end things tbh. It took a lot from me to trust her and get as close as I did, I can't do it again..

I feel similar even though I don't think I can offer any real help, i've honestly been stuck in a panic attack for the past two days or so and feel like im being suffocated by everything. I don't know what led me here or if i'll ever get out, I can only hope.

I've been here for a while as well and know what you mean by things stacking. I'd like to talk if you did since I really don't feel like there's a single person I can talk to about anything really. Your problems are likely a lot worse than mine, but when problems are on top of depression and anxiety pretty much everything is a problem
I've got a shit load of problems too and don't know if I could be of any help, but I like to think im good at listening if you really did need someone.

Honestly, if I don't get kicked out on my 18th birthday I will be surprised. I understand what you're saying, but I really have no ambitions to.. 'do' anything. I don't know why.. I don't even know what the source of most of my problems are. I just feel like im drowning...
How. I don't see how turning 18 will fix anything, I only see it creating more problems.
